name: 子租赁会计核算的租出 – 集团分类账 IFRS (UPA) (6EE)
name_en: Lease-Out for Sublease Accounting – Group Ledger IFRS (UPA) (6EE)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item supports the lease-out scenario in a sublease contract.

A sublease is a lease agreement between a lessee who already holds a lease contract and another party called the sublessee who wants to use of the object of the original lease contract. The lessee assigns or gives certain rights to the sublessee that are held under the terms of the original lease with the owner.

In a lease-out scenario, the lessee who already has a lease-in contract with the lessor, creates a lease-out contract that includes the IFRS 16 compliant valuation to support the sublease option.

Key Process Flow

  • Create contract
  • Maintain contract
  • Make adjustments
  • Integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and C4RE
  • Perform periodic posting contract
  • Post contract valuation
  • Change customer
  • Report contract
  • End contract
  • Perform administration tasks

Business Benefits

  • Support compliance requirements for lease-out scenarios
  • Support comprehensive leasing processes within IFRS 16
  • Standardize and automate your recurring lease administration activities
  • Gain full control and visibility of leases and critical dates
  • Monitor critical dates on your leases, such as lease notifications and renewal
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目支持子租赁合同中的租赁协议场景。

子租赁是已持有租赁合同的承租人与另一方（想要使用原始租赁合同对象的子承租人）之间的租赁协议。承租人向子承租人转让或授予特定权利，这些权利根据与所有者签订的原始租赁条款而保留。

在租赁协议场景中，已与出租人签订租入合同的承租人创建包含 IFRS 16 合规性评估的租出合同，以支持子租赁选项。

关键流程流

  • 创建合同
  • 维护合同
  • 进行调整
  • 集成 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 和 C4RE
  • 执行定期过账合同
  • 过账合同评估
  • 更改客户
  • 报告合同
  • 结束合同
  • 执行管理任务

业务优势

  • 支持租赁协议场景的合规性要求
  • 支持 IFRS 16 内的全面租赁流程
  • 标准化和自动化周期性租赁管理活动
  • 获得租赁和关键日期的完全控制和可见性。
  • 监控租赁的关键日期，例如租赁通知和续订
